notes.title: Patch 1.2 is up to date !!
notes.notes:
Patch 1.2 is up to date! Hello everyone, Patch 1.2 is ready. What will you find in this Update?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38855502/2c78ff12ae1878e4c736c08926d38fbba64743da.png[/img] 2 new boats: The Twistales boat and a promotional boat with our UPDATE IT partner in Clermont-Ferrand.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38855502/2c78ff12ae1878e4c736c08926d38fbba64743da.png[/img] 1 modification of the old LDLC boat which becomes BOAT 98.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38855502/2c78ff12ae1878e4c736c08926d38fbba64743da.png[/img] Added rain in weather options.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38855502/2c78ff12ae1878e4c736c08926d38fbba64743da.png[/img] Overall game performance improvements.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38855502/2c78ff12ae1878e4c736c08926d38fbba64743da.png[/img] UI redesign. Which are now scalable
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38855502/2c78ff12ae1878e4c736c08926d38fbba64743da.png[/img] Added world best timer GHOST. You will now be able to see how the best player in the world managed to do much better than you.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38855502/2c78ff12ae1878e4c736c08926d38fbba64743da.png[/img] Modification of the Time Attack to facilitate time trials: Addition of a quick restart and a START FULL TURBO.


Enjoy!!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38855502/f9be3f735e1693158049a314000da42feed36d42.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.notes:
[h1][/h1]The first Riding Seas’ patch note arrives Monday, April 4, 2022! 

[h2][/h2]On the menu :

:check:  [b]New imput system[/b] supporting all types of controllers! 
:check:  Integration of [b]the remote system[/b]. You can now invite friends to your games to play up to 4 via Steam.
:check:  Tutorial update : 
[list] [*] Ability to quit after one lap, bug fixes, reworked explanatory panels. [/list]
:check:  Mirror mode now displays ingame. 
:check:  [b]Career[/b] difficulty adjustment: advance and master modes go from 5 to 4 turns.
:check:  New display for [b]Time Attack[/b]: 
[list][*] You will now know with which boat the best time was achieved. 
[*] The best time is displayed in the circuit selection. 
[*] Correction of the strobe effect. [/list]
:check:  10 new Steam Achievements.
:check:  1 [b]new boat[/b], the Patricia, unlockable by completing the “All Grand Prix” Achievement.
:check:  3 [b]new languages[/b]: Italian, Portuguese and German.
:check:  Many bugs fixed.

notes.title: Closing of the Demo
notes.notes:
From January 24, the Riding Seas demo will be disabled.

It will give way to the final version of the game which will be released on January 31.

We will meet again in a week for the official release.

Many thanks to our testers and everyone who tested the demo!

Warning ! All accounts will be reset.

notes.title: Patch Note close BETA 0.98
notes.notes:
Almost 2 months have passed since our last STEAM FEST Update in October!

But why did you wait so long? Following a very large number of requests and in order to bring the game to other platforms, we have rethought the heart of the game in order to offer you a local multiplayer mode up to 4 in split screen.
It is with great joy that today we can present the following PATCH Notes to you. There are so many new features that we couldn't list everything for you, but here is a non-exhaustive list of what to expect if you have obviously requested a BETA Key!
ːsteammockingː 

[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38855502/2c78ff12ae1878e4c736c08926d38fbba64743da.png[/img] Changed the core of the game. Single races can now be played up to 8.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38855502/2c78ff12ae1878e4c736c08926d38fbba64743da.png[/img] Modification of the circuit selection menu to allow you to configure your route.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38855502/2c78ff12ae1878e4c736c08926d38fbba64743da.png[/img]   Implementation of the game translation tool: French version has 80% translated.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38855502/2c78ff12ae1878e4c736c08926d38fbba64743da.png[/img]  Improvement of the Shipyard.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38855502/2c78ff12ae1878e4c736c08926d38fbba64743da.png[/img]  Implementation of the Mirror mode, accessible via the Single Race and the time attack.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38855502/2c78ff12ae1878e4c736c08926d38fbba64743da.png[/img] Fixed various navigation bugs.
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38855502/2c78ff12ae1878e4c736c08926d38fbba64743da.png[/img] Numerous adjustments and visual corrections of some maps: (Green arrows, new buoys, improvement of Italian canal, Golden Valley ...)
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38855502/2c78ff12ae1878e4c736c08926d38fbba64743da.png[/img] Added the ability to disable the game interface.
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38855502/2c78ff12ae1878e4c736c08926d38fbba64743da.png[/img] Added many animations in the game menu.
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38855502/2c78ff12ae1878e4c736c08926d38fbba64743da.png[/img] Addition of a local battle mode, with the possibility of playing up to 4 in split screen.
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38855502/2c78ff12ae1878e4c736c08926d38fbba64743da.png[/img]Changed the time attack interface to compare to other players in real time.
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38855502/2c78ff12ae1878e4c736c08926d38fbba64743da.png[/img] the ghost now changes depending on the selected boat.
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38855502/2c78ff12ae1878e4c736c08926d38fbba64743da.png[/img]  collision corrections.
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38855502/2c78ff12ae1878e4c736c08926d38fbba64743da.png[/img]  and lots of other things to discover ....!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38855502/dcf5ca875fdb4779aefec5f98fb8129f1c29e5d7.png[/img]

We still have beta keys available until December 31, 2021. Join us on DISCORD: [url=https://discord.gg/24j5ptr ]https://discord.gg/24j5ptr [/url] And request your Key! !

notes.title: Time Attack TOURNAMENT
notes.notes:
[b]On Wednesday 6 October, starting at 8:00 p.m.[/b], the first [b]Riding Seas[/b] time attack TOURNAMENT will take place.

On the program, a short présentation of the game by the dev team, then from 8:30 p.m. hostilities start. for 3 hours, players will compete on 5 maps that they do not know since none of the participants has yet got their hands on the game.

The goal: 5 laps to set the best time, each one will pilot with the same boat for a perfect equality of chances. Only the players with the best skills will finish the game!

The whole evening will be organized and broadcast by the French and Clermont team

notes.title: Patch note beta demo 0.94
notes.notes:
A number of bugs were reported to us following the launch of the demo at the start of NEO FEST.
We planned the release of Patch Note 0.94 in Day1, but it took longer than expected to deploy.
We are sorry for the inconvenience!
ːSteamthumbsupː The patch is now live and we hope you can enjoy the full potential of our demo.

If you don't see this version of the game:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38855502/dac3e8e618b57475895c7ff63cdd453b824b3567.jpg[/img]
Uninstall the game to start over on the correct version.


Here is the non-exhaustive list of improvements in version 0.94:

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38855502/2c78ff12ae1878e4c736c08926d38fbba64743da.png[/img] Fixed some menu navigation bugs
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38855502/2c78ff12ae1878e4c736c08926d38fbba64743da.png[/img] Correction of display errors in some Grand-Prix menus
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38855502/2c78ff12ae1878e4c736c08926d38fbba64743da.png[/img] Fixed the bug on the ramps that threw us off the track

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38855502/2c78ff12ae1878e4c736c08926d38fbba64743da.png[/img] Added some TIPS on the loading screen.
  [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38855502/2c78ff12ae1878e4c736c08926d38fbba64743da.png[/img] Fixed explosion bug
  [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38855502/2c78ff12ae1878e4c736c08926d38fbba64743da.png[/img] Fixed bug launching the tutorial
  [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38855502/2c78ff12ae1878e4c736c08926d38fbba64743da.png[/img] Correction of the menu display bug after returning to the tutorial
  [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38855502/2c78ff12ae1878e4c736c08926d38fbba64743da.png[/img] Noticeable improvements to Ais as part of the demo launch.

notes.title: ALPHA is OVER !
notes.notes:
Hello everyone.
As announced in August, the Alpha Keys from the game have been removed. it will be impossible to play the old version of the game via STEAM.
Only the demo is still available for a few days.
During September we will set up a new public demo so that it will be available for the Steam Fest in October.
On this occasion the database will be reinitialized because the connection system changes and the management of accounts also. :warning: All scores and unlocked boats will be reset to zero.
From this same date, Beta Testing keys will be put in place but will be more selective so that REAL tests can take place.
A dedicated area will be set up on the Discord so that we can exchange.
We are going to ask @Streamers who will also have access to the beta if they wish in order to have as many streams as possible during STEAM FEST.
We will keep you informed of the progress but you can react on our discord : [url=discord.gg/24j5ptr]discord.gg/24j5ptr[/url]
